API & CLI Reference ​

Core CLI (soroban-budget-core) ​

The core Go binary is the workhorse of BudgetGate.

Flags ​

FlagTypeDefaultDescription
--fixturestring""Required. Path to the JSON fixture defining the simulated transactions.
--output-jsonstring""Path to save the resulting snapshot.json. Necessary for GitHub action caching.
--baselinestring""Path to a previous snapshot.json to calculate regression deltas.
--max-delta-pctfloat10.0The maximum percentage increase allowed for any resource before failing the CI check.
--networkstring"testnet"The network limits to enforce (testnet, mainnet). Determines absolute caps.

Request Shapes ​

The JSON fixture.json expects the following schema: ```json [ { "function_name": "mint", "xdr": "AAAAAgAAAA..." } ] ```

Response Shapes ​

The tool outputs a `snapshot.json` conforming to: ```json { "functions": { "mint": { "CPUInstructions": 10500, "MemoryBytes": 2048, "ReadBytes": 512, "WriteBytes": 128 } } } ```
